examples.name: Constraint scheduling as JSON
examples.description: Default thinking (high) on a multi-constraint planning problem, returned as strict JSON.

parts.text:
Schedule 30-minute 1:1s between Maya (CST) and each of: Ana (PT), Ben (PT), Chloé (CET), Dieter (CET), Eli (CST) on Thursday.
Rules:
- Maya is free 09:00-15:00 CST.
- CET people only meet 08:00-17:00 their local time.
- PT people only meet after 08:00 their local time.
- Ana and Ben must not be scheduled back to back.
- Rooms: Austin (video), Lisbon (video), Oak (no video). Anyone outside CST needs a video room.
- No two meetings overlap.
Return only JSON: {"meetings":[{"person":string,"start_cst":"HH:MM","room":string,"reason":string}]}, sorted by start time, with a one-line reason per meeting.

output.text: {"meetings":[{"person":"Chloé","start_cst":"09:00","room":"Lisbon","reason":"Fits Maya's 09:00-15:00 CST availability and Chloé's 16:00-16:30 CET window with required video."},{"person":"Dieter","start_cst":"09:30","room":"Austin","reason":"Fits Maya's availability and Dieter's final 16:30-17:00 CET slot with required video."},{"person":"Ana","start_cst":"10:30","room":"Lisbon","reason":"Starts at 08:30 PT (after 08:00 PT) in a video room and avoids being back-to-back with Ben."},{"person":"Eli","start_cst":"11:00","room":"Oak","reason":"Local CST meeting using the non-video room while separating Ana's and Ben's meetings."},{"person":"Ben","start_cst":"11:30","room":"Austin","reason":"Starts at 09:30 PT (after 08:00 PT) in a video room and is not back-to-back with Ana."}]}

parts.text:
Summarize this customer email in 3 bullets, label the sentiment (positive / neutral / negative / mixed), and draft a polite reply under 80 words.

hi so i ordered the standing desk (order 88213) on the 2nd,,, tracking said delivered tuesday but nothing here
asked my neighbor too. nothing.
i already took the day off work to wait for it which im not thrilled about
also the confirmation email said 2 boxes but tracking only shows one??
your chat bot just kept sending me the same faq link
i like the desk honestly, my friend has one, i just want it to actually show up
if its lost can you send another one or refund, either is fine i guess
but i need it before the 20th bc i start a new job remote
thanks
- Dana
sent from my phone sorry for typos

output.text:
**Summary:**
* Dana’s standing desk (Order #88213) was marked as delivered on Tuesday, but neither she nor her neighbor received it, despite her taking the day off work to wait for it.
* There is a discrepancy between her confirmation email (2 boxes) and the tracking details (1 box), and she was frustrated by the unhelpful support chatbot.
* Although she likes the desk, she is requesting a replacement or a refund and needs the issue resolved before the 20th for a new remote job.

**Sentiment:** Mixed (frustrated with the delivery and chatbot experience, but polite and positive about the product itself).

**Draft Reply:**
Hi Dana,

I’m so sorry for the frustration with your missing desk, the wasted day off, and our chatbot. I am looking into Order #88213 and the missing second box tracking right now. 

Congratulations on your new remote job! We will contact the carrier immediately and ensure you receive a replacement or a full refund well before the 20th. I will follow up with an update within 24 hours.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
